description:
The 20x Sport is the ultimate vehicle for building balance and mastering the art of cycling.

First, we changed the world with the Strider Bike. That wasn’t enough. Why? We believe everyone, regardless of their current skill or ability, should have the chance to ride a bike. Because it’s awesome.

With an incredible amount of adjustability, the Strider balance bike for adults ensures the bike always fits and the fun never stops. Our Strider Scientists spent many nights in our top-secret lab perfecting the 20x Sport for people who may not have learned to ride a bike when they were younger.

This model breaks down the overwhelming task of learning how to ride a bike into a safe and natural progression. All in all, this is the learn-to-ride tool for everyone seeking better coordination and more confidence on two wheels.

We hear it all the time that people with cognitive, developmental, or physical disabilities are told that they probably won't be able to ride a bike. Designed with a low stand-over-height, this bike provides a low center of gravity, so it’s ultra-stable while riders focus on learning balance first.

Once you master balancing, simply attach the 4-bolt Pedal Kit (sold separately) to the 20x Sport and convert your bike to become a pedaling pro. The narrow pedals provide plenty of space to stride around and then place your feet on them with ease.

Learning to ride a bike builds the confidence that changes everything! And it’s never too late to learn. Step into the world of inclusive cycling with the Strider 20x Sport.
